newsitem.title: USA: Uncle B's sees profitability in Q1 FY97.
newsitem.headline: Uncle B's sees profitability in Q1 FY97.

text.p: Uncle B's Bakery Inc said on Thursday it expects an increase in sales and a return to profitability in fiscal 1997, beginning with the first quarter.

The company said that with the new bake-off product currently being manufactured, net sales could be expected to increase 40 to 50 percent, with little, if any, additional related product development, sales, marketing or promotional cost.

The company reported a loss of $0.51 per share for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996, ended July 31, and a loss of $1.01 per share for the full year, including an accounting change charge of $0.40. Net sales were $4.3 million for the fourth quarter and $17.4 million for the year.
